welcome.title: Open a project area
welcome.body: Pick the be guide inside a project area, or choose a folder directly. be stores the project configuration, partitions and build file list.

project.noFiles: No source files in this project

device.title: Target device
device.modelNote: CH340 identifies the serial bridge. Probe to confirm the actual chip.

device.probeHint: Reads chip information without writing firmware.
memory.title: Resource usage
layout.title: Flash layout
layout.subtitle: Scroll over the map to zoom, drag partition edges to resize, or select one to edit it.
layout.name: Partition name
layout.hint: Select a partition to edit its name, type and size. The saved layout is used by the next build and flash.
layout.validation: Partitions must stay inside Flash and must not overlap. App offsets use 64 KiB alignment.
layout.regionOverlap: Firmware exceeds the application region and overlaps:

console.empty: Build, upload and chip identification output will appear here.

console.serialInput: Send a message to the device…
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Project, toolchain, debug probe drivers and language in one place.
settings.note: Installing the ESP32 toolchain can take a few minutes. It only changes when you update it. Third-party indexes must use HTTPS.
settings.name: Project name
settings.openProjectFirst: Open a project to edit project settings; drivers and language work without one.
settings.driverNote: ST-Link is the common debug probe for STM32. The official Windows driver package is bundled so it can be installed offline or when Windows does not match it automatically.
driver.unboundHint: Install or repair the driver, then reconnect the ST-Link.
driver.packageMissing: Bundled package tools/STSW-LINK/stsw-link009.zip is missing, so automatic installation is unavailable.
driver.windowsOnly: This driver only applies to Windows; nothing to install here.
driver.desktopOnly: Drivers can only be installed from the desktop app.
driver.uacHint: Installation requests administrator rights and may show a UAC prompt; reconnect the probe afterwards.
settings.native: Managed and third-party tools share the same build interface.
ai.title: Automation
ai.subtitle: Let local AI tools read the project, build and flash.
ai.external: External access is enabled; append ?token=TOKEN when opening the link remotely.
ai.syncDrafts: Sync editor content to the browser
ai.independent: Sync is off; this is an independent workspace.
ai.docs: Full protocol and MCP setup: docs/AI-PIPE.md.
ai.security: Keys live in your user folder. AI and the UI share the same checks; flashing needs explicit confirmation.
ai.mcpHint: Use dist/mcp-bridge.mjs to connect the local pipe to an MCP client.
